image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of green moss and brown earth. The salamander's body is oriented diagonally across the frame, showcasing its glossy black skin with distinct, irregular yellow spots. The head is visible on the left, and the tail extends towards the upper left corner. One forelimb and one hindlimb are clearly visible, planted on the ground.
